text: Presentation by Toronto Shelter and Support Services (TSSS) and The 519 providing an overview of the homelessness system, along with recent initiatives to better support 2SLGBTQ+ people experiencing homelessness. It highlights key data, system improvements, and partnerships aimed at advancing more inclusive and affirming homelessness responses.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Manager, Gender Equity, Social Development to request the Project Director, Homelessness Initiatives and Prevention Services to provide an update on Initiatives to Support 2SLGBTQ+ Communities Experiencing Homelessness in the new term of Council.
